wikipediaExtract: The George Madurobrug (bridge 1036) is a structure in Amsterdam-Zuidoost, a combination of a bridge and a viaduct. wikipediaExtract: De Zaagpoort (bridge no. 161) is a fixed bridge between the centre of Amsterdam and the Amsterdam-West borough. It connects the Marnixplein and Marnixstraat on one side with the Frederik Hendrikplantsoen and Nassaukade on the other, crossing the Singelgracht. The covered Marnixbad stood beside it before it was demolished and replaced.

wikipediaExtract: De Katterug (bridge no. 1935) is a bridge over the Hugo de Grootgracht in Amsterdam-West. It connects the foot and cycle path continuing from the Van Reigersbergenstraat and the Hugo de Grootkade with the Bilderdijkpark, and lies in line with the Bilderdijkkade. It owes its name to its rather steep slope and profile, recalling a cat's back.

wikipediaExtract: The Korte Ouderkerkerbrug (bridge 1962) is a cycle and foot bridge in the Overamstel district on the right bank of the Amstel in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Duivendrechtsevaart, connecting the western part of the Korte Ouderkerkerdijk, just past the Zuidergasfabriekbrug (bridge 311) where the cycle path begins, with the Joan Muyskenweg.

wikipediaExtract: The Hendrick Jacobsz. Staetsbrug (bridge 35) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the west bank of the Amstel and spans the Herengracht, which ends here. wikipediaExtract: Brug 66 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge lies in line with the Runstraat, heading out of the city, and crosses the Prinsengracht. Unlike the bridges north of it, this one does connect to a through traffic route, that of the northern quay of the Looiersgracht. The bridge is not a monument itself.

name: Piet Meerburgbrug

wikipediaExtract: The Piet Meerburgbrug (bridge 234) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge crosses two parallel culverts, which connect an ornamental pond in the Hortus Botanicus Amsterdam with the water of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht. It links the Hortusplantsoen on the west side with the northern quay of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht.

name: Brug 142

wikipediaExtract: Brug 142 is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Willemsstraat with the Nieuwe Willemsstraat, spanning the Lijnbaansgracht. A temporary wooden bridge was placed here in 1882, after the local crossing of the Lijnbaansgracht at the Palmstraat was demolished; a tender for a permanent bridge followed only in 1887.

name: Brug 73

wikipediaExtract: Brug 72 and Brug 73 are two fixed bridges in Amsterdam-Centrum. They lie in the quays of the Prinsengracht and cross the Reguliersgracht. Bridge 73 is on the city side (north, odd numbers) and bridge 72 on the outer side (south, even numbers). Both are surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

wikipediaExtract: The Veeneikbrug is a cycle and foot bridge connecting the Bijlmerweide in Amsterdam-Zuidoost to the west with the Diemerbos in Diemen to the east. It crosses the provincial road N236 on the Amsterdam side, the Gaasp and Weespertrekvaart, and the Stammerdijk on the Diemen side.

wikipediaExtract: The Odebrug, or ODE-brug, short for Oosterdokseiland, is a fixed bridge in the centre of Amsterdam connecting Oosterdokseiland with the Prins Hendrikkade. It is made of prefabricated concrete elements, steel and aluminium and consists of three parts. The pedestrian deck is finished with finely ground basalt grit.

name: Hartmanbrug

wikipediaExtract: The Hartmanbrug (bridge no. 190) is a slab bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It lies in the Molukkenstraat and spans the Ringvaart, connecting the Indische Buurt with the Watergraafsmeer. name: Leeuwenputbrug

wikipediaExtract: The Leeuwenputbrug (bridge 371) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. This traffic bridge lies in the Grasweg and spans the Buiksloterkanaal; on the east side of the canal the Grasweg meets the Ranonkelkade. wikipediaExtract: The Charley Tooropbrug (bridge 656) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the Postjesweg and spans a ditch running parallel to the Ringspoorbaan and metro line 50. name: Oude Kinkerbrug

wikipediaExtract: The Oude Kinkerbrug (bridge 169) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Elandsgracht with the Kinkerstraat, spanning the Singelgracht between them. The Appeltjesmarkt lies to its north-east and Amsterdam's police headquarters of 1941 to its south-east. The Europarking car park is also nearby.

wikipediaExtract: The Lijnbaansbrug (bridge 10) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Lijnbaanssteeg with the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal, spanning the Singel. A bridge has been here for centuries: it is drawn on Pieter Bast's map of 1599, running from the Lijnbaan Steech to the Blaeuwe Burchwal.

name: De Duifbrug

wikipediaExtract: De Duifbrug, also Duyfjesbrug or Duyfjessluis, is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the eastern quay of the Reguliersgracht over the Prinsengracht. On the south side of the Prinsengracht here the whole frontage consists of municipal and national monuments, the best known being the 1857 church De Duif, after which the bridge is named.

name: Kadoelenbrug

wikipediaExtract: The Kadoelenbrug (bridge 1787) is a bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The name refers to the Kadoelen area north of the bridge. It was built between 29 August 2011 and May 2013 for just under 2.5 million euros, although the official opening took place on 4 July 2012.

wikipediaExtract: The Pia Beckbrug (bridge number 1868) is a fixed bridge in Slotervaart, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. wikipediaExtract: The Cecilia van Alphen-Jagtmanbrug (bridge 912) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. It connects the Buiksloterdijk to the west with a T-junction to the east. wikipediaExtract: Gustav Leonhardtbrug (bridge 449) is a fixed bridge in the Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. wikipediaExtract: The Geert Geertsenbrug (bridge 395) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West. The footbridge lies on the western edge of the Erasmuspark and provides access from the Hondiusstraat and Mercatorstraat, spanning the ring ditch around the park. The bridge dates from around 1970.

wikipediaExtract: The Hennetjesbrug (bridge 179) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. It lies in the Nicolaas Beetsstraat and spans the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. wikipediaExtract: The Kattenburgerbrug (bridge 274) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The boundary between the Oosterdok and the Nieuwe Vaart runs beneath it.

wikipediaExtract: The Mariniersbrug is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum, bridge number 272. The traffic bridge lies in line with the Kattenburgerstraat (S116) and spans the Dijksgracht. wikipediaExtract: The Johan Neeskensbrug (bridge 2237) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost.
